scope: Paired analysis and eval/no_grad inference only; no training, checkpoint mutation, production export, or test-based method selection.
smoke: Same command with --limit 2; existing completed sample rows skipped in full continuation after provenance match.
alpha_half_intervention: skipped: amplitude dominance not supported by the diagnostic evidence
formal_metrics_policy: All main comparisons retain the original terminal evaluation numbers. New pixel statistics and maps are diagnostic only.
runtime_policy: Per-image elapsed_seconds includes forward, device transfers and pixel statistics, excluding model/data loading and selected-array serialization; allocator peak is not whole-device or other-user memory.
dependencies: No new dependencies: standard library for summary/audit; existing server NumPy, PyTorch and Matplotlib for inference/plots.
deliberate_limits: No second seed, extended training, Joint stage, or representation change.
No custom boundary-band metric; existing formal Boundary F1 retained.
Only selected 12 samples retain dense diagnostic arrays per arm.
Proposed iteration-supervision change is a future hypothesis, not implemented or trained.
